title: Replacement of street light poles and electrical accessories and supply of electrical equipment at Navinal VTS station under VTS Directorate Gandhidham
summary: GeM BoQ bid to replace 29 street light poles with LED fittings, bollard and flood lights, underground cabling, and to supply and install electrical accessories, a pump, fans and utilities at Navinal VTS and Lighthouse Station, Mundra, Gujarat, for the VTS Directorate, Gandhidham.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, VTS Directorate, Gandhidham

sites.name: Navinal VTS & Lighthouse Station, Adani Port Mundra, Dist. Kutch, Gujarat 370421
sites.work: Replacement of street light poles and electrical accessories; supply of electrical equipment

money.performance_security: ePBG 5% of contract value, valid 39 months from installation and commissioning (FDR from any commercial bank)
money.notes: Estimated cost including GST and all taxes. EMD advisory bank SBI; EMD exemption only for OEM bidders, not resellers (ATC 1.2). MII purchase preference (L1+20%, up to 50% quantity; Class 1/Class 2 local suppliers only) and MSE purchase preference (L1+15%, 25% quantity). Payment: 50% on supply with warranty certificate, 40% 15 days after installation/testing, 10% after 30 days of successful working. LD 0.5% per day up to 5%; contract cancelled if delay exceeds 15 days.

period.warranty: Minimum 3 years for all items; defects attended within 72 hours, spares replaced within 15 days, penalty Rs 500/day

eligibility: Minimum average annual turnover of bidder (3 years): Rs 7 lakh; OEM average turnover (3 years): Rs 30 lakh
3 years past experience for same/similar service; past performance 80% of bid quantity; no MSE/startup exemption for experience and turnover
Similar works in last 7 years ending 30 September 2025: three works each >= 40%, or two each >= 50%, or one >= 80% of estimated cost
Similar works: supply/installation of electrical wiring/street light/electrical equipment in Central/State Govt/PSU/autonomous body, proved by completion certificate or GeM CRAC
Undertaking of not being blacklisted (Annexure III); technical compliance declaration (Annexure I); tender acceptance letter (Annexure II); GST registration
Detailed technical brochure with make and model of items; declaration of site awareness (Annexure VII)
OEM authorization certificate and compliance of BoQ specification required on GeM
specs: Poles: Class C GI heavy duty 65mm NB, OD 3 in, 5mm wall, 15 ft, single piece without joints, 300x300mm MS base plate, 2 ft arms at 45 degrees; preferred make TATA/Jindal/Asian
LED street light 25W 230V with surge protection, IP66 or better; preferred Surya/Havells/Crompton/Philips

Cables: 1.5 sq.mm x 3C XLPE copper armoured (Finolex/Polycab/KEI/RR); junction box 250x200x100mm (Sintex/RMW/Indo)
2HP monoblock pump, head 25m, self-priming (Texmo/Kirloskar/Havells/CRI); washing machine 6.5kg front load (IFB/LG/Samsung)
All electrical items BIS/ISI certified; make/model to be approved by DDG-VTS before supply
GeM categories referenced: LED Luminaire for Road and Street Lights conforming to IS 10322 (Part 5/Section 3); cable trunking and ducting system

notes: 39-page GeM bid document (total quantity 2227 across 60 BoQ lines, delivery 45 days, two packet bid, no reverse auction) followed by buyer ATC with scope, specifications, BoQ (rates blank) and annexures including an electrical accessories location table.
